hints.title: Ordered Binary Search Property Rebuilding
hints.text: The search ordering constraint implies that a preorder sequence alone determines tree structure without requiring null markers.

hints.title: Recursive Range Partitioning
hints.text: Serialize using preorder traversal. During deserialization, reconstruct nodes recursively by enforcing lower and upper numeric boundaries for each subtree.

hints.title: Bounded Reconstruction Blueprint
hints.text: In serialize: append node.val in preorder. In deserialize: parse tokens into queue of integers. Define build(min_val, max_val): peek queue; if empty or value out of bounds return None; pop value, instantiate node, set left = build(min, val) and right = build(val, max).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Preorder traversal and bounded parsing each process every node in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General tree serializers store null sentinels, which waste unnecessary bandwidth on BST structures.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: BST range constraints eliminate sentinel storage completely.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: O(N) reconstruction using min/max bounds rather than searching for split indices in O(N^2).

solutions.approach: Preorder Stream Serialization with Range-Bounded Reconstruction
